mesh_bind_pose: Canonical T pose; shoulder, elbow and wrist geometry aligns with canonical joint centres
armature_pose_at_export: identity matrix_basis on every bone; no pose offsets or constraints

weights.distal_arm_influences: elbow/wrist/hand influences must be local in aligned T space
weights.hair: Head dominant; smooth only connected hair/garment junctions; no additional hair bones
weights.cloth: Torso and appropriate local limb chains; validate deformations with the common clips

acceptance.policy: Passing numeric rig/skin checks alone is insufficient. Each new mesh needs static and dynamic visual acceptance. A fixed 165cm envelope does not prove identical clothing and shoe contacts.
